oldFailure: The bridge gives way over deep water. The assurance of protection cannot keep you afloat.
ordinarySetback: The plank breaks near the bank. You crawl out coughing, having reached the far side of your confidence rather than the river.
catastropheCause: Drowned after choosing to cross a visibly broken bridge.

oldFailure: The condemned section parts over the quarry. The last assurance you hear is that it held yesterday.
ordinarySetback: The rope parts above a lower shelf. You survive the fall with a broken bone; the rope seller describes this as useful information.
catastropheCause: Killed in a fall while testing a condemned rope.

oldFailure: Lightning strikes the exposed roof. The promised hazard payment is no defence against it.
ordinarySetback: A gust throws you against the roof and the crowd scatters. Your fee is spent on treating the burns before anybody can call it a profit.
catastropheCause: Killed while knowingly holding an iron pole on a roof during a storm.

oldFailure: The overloaded boat capsizes in deep water. The extra fare cannot purchase a shore.
ordinarySetback: The ferry rolls and you reach the shallows clinging to a bundle. The ferryman asks you to stop counting the passengers aloud.
catastropheCause: Drowned after choosing an overloaded ferry.

oldFailure: The ledge crumbles beneath you. The shorter route has no place to stop the fall.
ordinarySetback: The ledge gives way into a scrub shelf. You reach the road with a broken bone and an entirely new respect for its length.
catastropheCause: Killed after choosing a dangerous shortcut through an abandoned quarry.

oldFailure: It came through the rats, through the very walls. There was no barricade against it.
ordinarySetback: The sickness reaches the house. You need care and lose strength, but the barred door has not decided the ending.
catastropheCause: Died of the Pestilence, alone behind a barred door.

oldFailure: You tended the sick, and the sickness took you in turn. A merciful death, the priest says. He is lying.
ordinarySetback: You fall ill after tending the sick. Another carer takes your place; accepting the bed is harder than offering it.
catastropheCause: Died of the Pestilence, tending those who could not be saved.

oldFailure: You fled, but carried the sickness with you. The fever finds you on the road.
ordinarySetback: The fever finds you on the road. A nearby household gives you shelter, and the illness must run its real course.
catastropheCause: Taken by the Pestilence on a lonely hill road.

oldFailure: A looter found you "dead" and was most surprised when you flinched. The scuffle did not go your way.
ordinarySetback: A looter finds you breathing and strikes before fleeing. You stagger out wounded, furious at having played the least convincing corpse on the field.
catastropheCause: Cut down by a battlefield looter while feigning death.
